summary: Revalidate live-folder resolution on sidebar projection cache hits

compatibility.detail: Cache hits compare ordered parent maps and live-folder identities. Missing or changed resolution clears the entry and delegates to full projection, retaining completeness-before-invalid-ancestry error precedence even at an unchanged arrangement revision.

manual.detail: No operator steps or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: Only in-memory cache validation changes; no persisted state or runtime recovery behavior changes.
